But the data points the other way. Net flow over the last 15 minutes is slightly negative (-5.69 SOL), sells (345 SOL) nearly match buys (339 SOL), and sellers (542) nearly equal buyers. The price is down 48% over 15 minutes and 86% from its 30-minute high. Buyers in the first two minutes sold more than they bought (sell-to-buy ratio 1.25), and 94% of curve buys came from bundles, with 91% from the completer. That pattern looks like coordinated volume rather than organic demand, and the bundle concentration suggests the early liquidity is operator-driven and may be unwinding.

Against the base rates, a buy here would be a dip-catch on a coin already down most of its high, with sellers in control, and the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost on a $20 ticket doesn't help.
